title: Ni hao cat coins
summary: Coins named for the "ni hao cat" meme after the trader Ansem adopted it. Some posts call the move a promotion by Ansem and question the coin's supply; those claims are not verified here, and Ansem's reasons are his own. Measured: three coins across all their pools.

title: Marvin the Martian coins
summary: Coins named Marvin The Martian after posts tie the Looney Tunes character to Elon Musk's dog. On 2021-01-26 Musk posted on X that he "bought a hand knit wool Marvin the Martian helm for my dog". On 2026-11-16 at 02:04 UTC the account Doge Tipping posted a 2020 photo of Musk with his dog at the SpaceX Starship SN8 wreckage beside a 2026 Starship photo; fan posts since July 2026 say the dog is named Marvin, which Musk's post does not say, and traders' posts of 2026-11-16 say Musk interacted with the photo, which was not found here. Three coins named Marvin The Martian, all with empty descriptions, are measured: one on Pump.fun (paired with SPCX) and two on Meteora DBC. Dates from Codex: their pools opened on 2026-11-16 at 03:43, 03:53 and 06:52 UTC, after the Doge Tipping post; older Marvin coins from 2024 and 2025 are not members. Posts say the name has been launched many times before. None of the coins is shown to be connected to Elon Musk, SpaceX or Warner Bros. Measured: three coins across all their pools.
